Policy.title: Terms & Privacy
Policy.intro: This page explains how this directory works, how your data is handled, and the terms that apply when you browse or contribute.

usage.title: 1. Purpose & use
usage.body: The service is an open, trilingual directory of deep-tech initiatives. It is provided for information purposes: browsing is free and does not require an account.

accounts.title: 2. Accounts & contributions
accounts.body: Submitting or saving content may require an account. Account data is limited to what is necessary to provide these features, and credentials are protected with industry-standard measures.

content.title: 3. Content & accuracy
content.body: Initiative entries are compiled and reviewed by editors. We make reasonable efforts to keep information current, but we do not guarantee completeness or accuracy. Company details, funding and contact information may change over time.

ip.title: 4. Intellectual property
ip.body: Content you submit remains yours. By submitting it you grant us a non-exclusive licence to display and maintain it in the directory. Logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

privacy.title: 5. Privacy
privacy.body: We collect only what is needed to run the service: account details you provide, items you save to your account, and anonymous usage data on the pages you visit. This data is never sold to third parties.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
cookies.body: We use a small number of cookies for core functions: language preference, visual theme, and session persistence when signed in. No advertising or cross-site tracking cookies are used.

liability.title: 7. Liability
liability.body: The service is provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind. We are not liable for how the directory is used or for decisions made on the basis of its content.

contact.title: 8. Contact & credits
contact.body: For any question about these terms or about your data, contact the team that maintains this directory.
contact.credit: Built by T. Chams at the Tebessa Incubator.
